clusters.name: overview-viewer-foundation
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial within the cluster: US-002 imports styles into the scaffold built in US-001. Workspace registration in US-001 must land before any other file is added under tools/overview-viewer/.

clusters.name: overview-viewer-components
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial: each story extends App.tsx to mount its new section and adds fields to schema.ts. Parallelizing risks merge conflicts in App.tsx and schema.ts even though the per-section components are exclusive.

clusters.name: overview-viewer-build-and-swap
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial and gated: US-008 is destructive (deletes plans/overview.html) and must follow operator approval of US-007's parity output. Cannot be parallelized with any other story.

clusters.name: overview-viewer-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Sole-story cluster; runs after the build/swap so docs reflect the final dev-server URL, build command, and deferred-class behavior.
